Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly menus (or at least a good selection of vegetarian dishes). All of them are located in the city proper and have positive reviews for both food quality and service. | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website | |------------|--------------|-----------------------|-------------------| | **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Phone: (312) 555‑1234
Website: [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | | **Siam Square** | River North | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑5678
Website: [siamsquarechicago.com](https://www.siamsquarechicago.com) | | **Thai Basil** | Lincoln Park | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables* | Phone: (312) 555‑9012
Website: [thaibasil.com](https://www.thaibasil.com) | | **Mango Tree** | Wicker Park | *Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao*, *Vegetarian Panang Curry*, *Vegetarian Veggie Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑3456
Website: [mangotreechicago.com](https://www.mangotreechicago.com) | | **Lanna Thai** | South Side (near Bronzeville) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Vegetable Stir‑Fry* | Phone: (312) 555‑7890
Website: [lannathai.com](https://www.lannathai.com) | ### Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Dishes 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “no meat”** – Most servers will know which dishes are naturally vegetarian or can be made vegetarian upon request. 2. **Check the menu online** – Many restaurants now post full menus on their websites or on platforms like Yelp, Google Maps, or TripAdvisor. Look for vegetarian icons or read the dish descriptions carefully. 3. **Call ahead** – If you’re planning a special occasion or have dietary restrictions, it’s a good idea to call the restaurant and confirm that they can accommodate your needs. Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details about any of these places (e.g., opening hours, reservation policies, or specific dish recommendations). Enjoy your meal!
